title: Transcription Service Tests
requirements: Add controllable mocks for SpeechTranscriber and WhisperClient via protocol injection (or @testable internal types) — not real SFSpeechRecognizer / URLSession
testSpeechSucceeds_NoWhisperFallback: mock Speech success and assert Whisper.transcribe is never called (call-count mock); final source == .speech
testWhisperFallback_WhenSpeechReturnsEmpty: mock Speech returning empty text; assert final source == .whisper
testWhisperFallback_WhenSpeechFails: mock a Speech throw; assert Whisper is invoked and final source == .whisper
testWhisperOnly_WhenSpeechDisabled: mock useOnDeviceSpeech=false; assert only Whisper runs and final source == .whisper
testBothFailed_FailedUpdateEmitted: mock both engine failures; assert TranscriptUpdate.failed is emitted with no .final
acceptance_criteria: All four fallback-scenario tests pass: speech-only success, whisper-only success, speech-failed-fallback-to-whisper, both-failed
Tests assert exactly which engine runs and what the final TranscriptSource is
No tests hit the network, mic, or on-device SFSpeechRecognizer
